description: Behavioral routing and decision scenarios for the design-patterns plugin.

cases.request: 현재 결제 수수료 계산은 카드 한 종류뿐인데 다음 릴리스에서 계약별로 서로 다른 세 계산 정책을 런타임에 선택해야 해. 호출 흐름은 유지하고 계산 정책만 교체 가능해야 한다. TypeScript 설계와 검증 방법을 정해 줘.
expected: Decision is use
object-oriented-strategy is the primary pattern
Implementation uses a TypeScript function type or small interface
Verification demonstrates policy replacement without caller changes
forbidden: Factory classes without a separate creation problem

cases.request: Python 함수에서 status가 active면 1, 아니면 0을 반환해. 나중 요구사항은 아직 없어. 어떤 디자인 패턴을 써야 해?
evidence: No recurring variation or lifecycle behavior
expected: Decision is no-pattern
A direct conditional or mapping is the baseline
No speculative State or Strategy structure
forbidden: Recommending a decision-ready pattern as primary

cases.request: 서비스 두 개가 이벤트로 통신하게 만들 거야. 적절한 패턴을 골라 줘.
evidence: No delivery, ordering, consistency, idempotency, or recovery contract is supplied
expected: Decision is insufficient-evidence
Requests only the missing facts that affect the decision
forbidden: Selecting Saga or Transactional Outbox as settled

cases.request: 주문 DB commit과 Kafka publish가 분리돼 commit 뒤 crash하면 이벤트가 빠진다. 분산 transaction은 지원하지 않고 consumer는 중복을 받을 수 있다. 누락을 막고 재시작 복구를 검증할 설계를 골라 줘.
expected: Decision is use
microservices-transactional-outbox is primary
An idempotent receiver is considered only as necessary support
Crash points, duplicate delivery, acknowledgement, and recovery are verified
forbidden: Treating broker publish and DB commit as atomic

cases.request: ORM session이 request transaction 동안 변경 추적과 commit/rollback을 이미 제공해. 별도 UnitOfWork 클래스를 추가해야 할까?
evidence: Framework owns change tracking and the transaction lifecycle
expected: Decision is no-pattern
The framework facility is the baseline
No duplicate UnitOfWork abstraction unless a missing guarantee is shown
forbidden: Recommending a wrapper only to expose the pattern name

cases.request: $review-pattern-usage 이 diff에서 Adapter라고 부른 HTTP client wrapper가 외부 DTO를 그대로 domain layer 전체에 전달하는 구조를 수정 없이 검토해 줘.
evidence: The wrapper changes method names but preserves the foreign model
expected: Finding explains that Adapter alone does not provide Anticorruption Layer semantic isolation
Trigger, actual behavior, required guarantee, and smallest correction are included
forbidden: Reporting the naming choice alone as the defect

cases.request: $review-pattern-usage 이 작은 parser가 함수 두 개와 명시적 분기로 되어 있다. 패턴 누락이나 오용이 있는지 수정 없이 검토해 줘.
expected: No finding is valid solely because no named pattern is present
Simple direct code can remain
forbidden: Forcing Chain of Responsibility or Strategy

cases.request: 이 null check를 고치고 테스트해 줘.
evidence: No pattern decision or review is requested
No recurring design forces are present
expected: select-design-patterns does not activate automatically
review-pattern-usage does not activate
forbidden: Turning an ordinary bug fix into a pattern catalog exercise
